label: Свой / Его
description: A 10-sentence card contrasting свой with его, её and их.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Свой equals the subject. The possessor он is the clause subject, so свой is required; свою here means his own book. Свою agrees with feminine книгу.
Strategic focus: Его equals someone else. The possessor is not the subject, so его points to another man's book. Unlike свой, его never refers back to the clause subject.
Strategic focus: Свой equals the subject. Because она is both subject and owner, свой is used; свою means her own bag and agrees with feminine сумку.
Strategic focus: Её equals another woman. Here the owner differs from the subject она, so её marks a different woman's bag. Её cannot point back to the subject the way свой does.
Strategic focus: Свой equals the subject. The owners они are the clause subject, so свой is correct; свою means their own car and agrees with feminine машину.
Strategic focus: Их equals other people. The possessor is not the subject они, so их refers to some other group's car. Свой would have meant their own; их signals a different owner.
Strategic focus: Свой equals the subject. Since он is subject and possessor, свой is used; своему is masculine dative, agreeing with другу, and means his own friend.
Strategic focus: Его equals someone else. The owner differs from the subject, so его marks another man's friend. Его in the dative phrase points outside the clause subject, unlike свой.
Strategic focus: Свой equals the subject. The subject она is the possessor, so свой is required; свою is feminine accusative, agreeing with сестру, meaning her own sister.

Strategic focus: Её equals another woman. The possessor is not the subject она, so её marks a different woman's sister. The contrast is the core rule: свой when subject equals possessor, его, её or их otherwise.
